note: Exploratory analyses for the co-author checklist of 27 Nov 2026, run 28 Nov 2026. Not pre-registered. Set A, reading position prefix, medium load, arrival seed 11 unless a section says otherwise. Every outcome is reported.

arms.q4p: retraining on the labelled Q4 vectors (registered arm)
arms.wsp: warm start: FP16 heads kept as offsets, a correction fitted on the labelled Q4 vectors with the FP16 scaler; the L2 penalty on the correction weights = penalty toward the FP16 weights (L2-SP); bias free; C chosen by inner grouped CV
arms.mft: map (all 1,000 unlabelled pairs) followed by the same L2-SP fine-tuning on the mapped labelled vectors
arms.bias: bias-only correction of the FP16 logits on raw Q4 vectors (as R9)
arms.vecs: vector scaling of the FP16 logits on raw Q4 vectors (as R9)
arms.mbias: map followed by bias-only correction of the FP16 logits

map_vs_all_label_retraining.note: Non-inferiority: the upper end of the 95% interval below the margin (the registered rule, margins 0.25 and 0.5 pp registered; the others are a sensitivity check). Equivalence (two one-sided tests at 5%): the 90% interval inside (-margin, +margin).

human_report_precision.note: Resampling E episodes of the registered set-A results; assumes human reports vary like the synthetic ones per episode, which is not known. A planning aid only.

variants.uav5_1th: 5 UAVs (UAV-04 RGB 18 m/s, UAV-05 RGB 16 m/s added), one thermal camera (UAV-02)
variants.uav5_2th: 5 UAVs, UAV-05 also THERMAL (two thermal cameras)
variants.burst: burst arrivals: 4 bursts of 5 reports, 2 s mean gap inside a burst, same expected episode length as medium load

K7_incident_accounting.formula: incidents = open incidents listed in the reports + gold CREATE records - gold CLOSE records (a closure at the report's own arrival time marks that incident never real; it is not counted)

K11_cpu_margins.note: Saved = GPU vectors of the study, deployed folded map classifier (float64); live margins are from disagreements.csv (min of the three field margins). Margin = top-1 minus top-2 logit; record margin = min over action and, for records that carry them, sensor and priority.
